description: This file is a PHP template that outputs JavaScript code responsible for rendering an interactive chart on the client side. It defines a function `printAmount()` which initializes a D3.js-based chart, handles data fetching from an API endpoint, and manages chart rendering and animations. The PHP parts inject dynamic data such as project ID and localization text into the JavaScript code.

methods.name: printAmount
methods.description: Initializes and renders a D3.js chart within a specific DOM container, including axes, legend, paths, and animated markers based on data fetched via AJAX.

methods.name: addAxesAndLegend
methods.description: Adds axes, clipping path, and legend elements to the SVG for the chart.

methods.name: drawPaths
methods.description: Draws the area and median line paths on the chart based on data.

methods.name: addMarker
methods.description: Adds animated markers to the chart indicating specific data points or events.

methods.name: startTransitions
methods.description: Manages the animated transition of chart elements and markers.

methods.name: makeChart
methods.description: Sets up the SVG, scales, axes, and calls subordinate functions to build and animate the chart.
